attack_surface.behaviour_change: a credential entry in an agent's queue file is addressed by the platform's reader chain (primary, else owner) and runs the kind's raise checks; the address the agent wrote is ignored; an entry that cannot be filed is held and named in the file's platform.ingestion marker; the sync fingerprint no longer compares the addressee or the stored destination of a credential row; the reach rules read the Workspace client block and a deactivated account, tri-state, failing closed in their yes/no forms; refusals under role_cannot_open_agent name their cause; the skill gate answers 503 gate_unavailable when it could not check

focus_verdicts.agent_picks_the_reader_through_the_file: no: the clamp sets the addressee from the poller's verdict and never reads the entry's address (filechannel.py:169-177); the reader comes from the native raise's own function (ask_service.py:1934-1942)
focus_verdicts.file_route_stores_a_destination_the_nati: no: one function validates on both routes (ask_service.py:1894-1909); delivery re-checks the name, the switch, the registry and the key against the stored row (credential_sink.py:307, 652-663, 571-598, 503-532)
focus_verdicts.changed_fields_exemption_redirects_a_sec: no: delivery reads the stored row only (client_portal/asks/service.py:858-862); a rewritten name, title, question or type is still flagged (filechannel.py:409-418)
focus_verdicts.disclosure: no address and no account state in any new message; cause and unchecked are attributes that no handler serialises (routers/operator_queue.py:703, skill_gate_errors.py:110); the marker is coarser than the native refusal and lists the agent's own entry ids
focus_verdicts.fail_closed: every new lookup that raises ends as could-not-check, read as no by the yes/no forms and as a refusal or a hold by the resolvers; the system-agent read returns False on error and only picks a sentence on a path that already refused
focus_verdicts.resource_bounds: per agent per cycle: entry-only checks on up to 500 entries, one reader chain, at most 10 registry reads, one log line per agent, entry and hold word
focus_verdicts.invariant_8: no route changed; refusals name roles; the agent-reach guard's exemption follows the predicate call to its new holder, whose callers all pass a role-resolved address
focus_verdicts.secrets_on_added_lines: none; addresses and the one URL are example.com; no private-tracker reference that is not already in the public tree at the merge base

coverage_gaps: No test was executed: the audit machine has no Python environment with the backend's dependencies and the stack was not to be used. The new test file, the changed test files and every guard the skill names were read, not run; CI is the evidence for them.

Substitute verification: a standard-library probe loaded the real role_addressing.py and filechannel.py with stub collaborators and drove 45 checks (reader chain under each failed lookup, tri-state reach, clamp, entry test against the clamp, both bounds, marker, fingerprint). 44 as expected; the 45th was the probe's own wrong expectation and the control it tested holds. ask_service.py was not loaded; its three file_credential functions were verified by reading.
Independent verifier not used: no finding reached the gate and no second agent was available; candidates were challenged in sequence by the auditor.
MCP server tests not run; the change there is text.
No live run: the 5-second cadence, the marker write-back and the Workspace door were read, not exercised.
The private tree was searched only for callers of the changed functions (two, both of the yes/no reach helper, both narrowed); its tests were not run.
The docs changes in the same working tree were out of scope.
